_comment: Endpoints for claude-superset-api (oci-apps, WG-only). Source of truth: cloud build.json ports (ip 10.0.0.6). Reachable from this host over the WireGuard mesh.
_sessions_comment: Cross-device session sync via the hub's /sessions store (on ep.api). device = this host's id (default: hostname); sync_keep = how many recent local sessions to push.
_mesh_comment: WireGuard mesh peers (the 4 VMs, per CLAUDE.md B.1). Consumed by the TUI status dashboard (CAS_MESH) for per-peer ICMP latency.
_public_comment: Public VM IPs (per CLAUDE.md B.1). TUI dashboard (CAS_PUBLIC) pings these to show public-edge reachability vs the WG mesh.
_image_comment: GHCR binaries image repo (no tag). TUI queries the anonymous manifest to show whether -binaries:latest is a native multi-arch list (amd64,arm64) or single-arch.
_setup_comment: `claude-superset setup` deps-solver/installer. Uses Anthropic's NATIVE installer (downloads.claude.ai binaries) — NOT npm. nix/termux are flake-managed (declarative); deb/other-linux/macos get the native binary; `setup --shell` runs it ephemerally via nix-shell.
_local_comment: `claude-superset local` runs the same container on THIS host via docker compose (on-demand). Listeners are published to 127.0.0.1 only (never the public NIC). Image is the multi-arch binaries tag (amd64 variant pulled here). First run needs a one-time login: `docker exec -it claude-superset-api-local claude`.
